LESSON: SIGN READING 1.2.2 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Sign Reading 1.2.2 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 1.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do pictures help us to know what the story is about? 2. Why is the meaning of words important in sign reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 1.2.2 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: Teamwork as the learner actively takes part in discussing pictures and the title of a text and making

predictions.

• Learning to Learn: The skill of reflection on own work as the learner interacts with the text and answers direct and indirect questions using

20

contextual clues.

Values:
Unity: Cooperates with others as they sign pictures and title of text during discussions

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Learner’s self-awareness is evident as he/she adopt the appropriate posture during sign reading

Link to other Learning Areas:

Kenyan Sign Language Activities, Mathematical Activities: Learner relates the skill of Sign reading fluency to these learning areas.
